audit: A.T.O.M product capability, UX and growth audit
head: d0763974e2b5b68c209fda5c680cdfd8b1bdde2a
status: PROPOSED ONLY — not filed; no GitHub state was changed

fold_into_existing.existing_issue: #86 Reconcile maintained roadmap status and unsupported API release promises
fold_into_existing.action: Add as a checklist item when #86 is worked; no new issue
Maintainer should verify acceptance criteria and close; not changed by this audit

issues.proposed_title: Fit the map to new results and area selections
issues.problem: Runs and area selections complete outside the visible map; users see only a status chip.
issues.scope: Request a fit when a new current result or area selection is produced, unless the user moved the map after starting the action.
acceptance_criteria: Run Sector, Evaluate Network, Optimize Network and Finish (area) fit to selected cells plus planning radius
No fit when the user panned/zoomed during the request
Fit selected cells button unchanged
Workflow test asserts a fit request per completed run and none for view-only toggles

issues.proposed_title: Explain the RF result headline and stop contradictory styling
issues.problem: Default result shows Blocked 99.2% next to a red Coverage Gaps card reporting 0 gaps; units render as 'DBm'/'M'.
issues.scope: Add one deterministic interpretation line distinguishing blocked rays from demand gaps; neutral styling when zero gaps; '—' for unavailable Worst Rx; remove capitalize transform from metric values.
acceptance_criteria: Units render exactly as produced ('dBm', 'm')
Zero-gap card uses neutral styling
Worst Rx shows '—' when no gaps are returned
Interpretation copy reviewed against docs/modeling-limits.md; no new thresholds
Unit test for the interpretation helper
issues.contributor_suitability: good first issue (units/styling); interpretation copy needs maintainer review
issues.github_cross_check: genuinely new; #76 (closed by PR #96) covered score/Pareto wording only

issues.proposed_title: Let users adopt Pareto alternatives produced from the working draft
issues.problem: Optimization in an unsaved draft produces runs without a source Version; Apply solution… is disabled with no recovery path.
issues.scope: Offer 'Save source as Version and apply' when the run's retained input fingerprint matches the draft or run snapshot; otherwise show the exact recovery step. Tell users the recommended solution is already in the draft.
acceptance_criteria: Apply from an unsaved-draft optimization creates a source Version from the run's retained input, then a new Version/branch with the chosen solution
Refused with a specific message if fingerprints do not match
Source run remains immutable
Persistence round-trip test (save → reload → lineage intact)

issues.proposed_title: Restore result context when reopening a draft or Version
issues.problem: Reload shows 'Run needed' (draft) or 'Ready · UNAVAILABLE · Run unavailable' (Version) although runs exist in history.
issues.scope: Design and implement exact-fingerprint rebinding of the latest compatible run summary on restore, presented as HISTORICAL with an explicit 'Restore map layers' action; bind pre-save runs to a Version when inputs match at save time.
acceptance_criteria: After reload the Results context shows the last compatible run summary with correct freshness
Command bar never shows 'Ready' and 'UNAVAILABLE' together
Restoring layers is an explicit, counted RF action
No rebinding when fingerprints differ (test)
non_goals: Persisting full ray GeoJSON by default

issues.proposed_title: Make plan comparison reachable for every result type
issues.problem: Results → Compare shows Baseline vs Recommended for network results, hiding saved-scenario comparison; input diff lives in a collapsed Scenarios disclosure.
issues.scope: Give Compare a source picker (current, baseline, saved Versions, Pareto alternative) combining KPI deltas, input diff and A/B map switch.
acceptance_criteria: A network user can compare two saved Versions from Results
Baseline vs Recommended remains available
Input diff reachable from the same view
Workflow test for both modes

issues.proposed_title: Expose candidate cell recommendation as a primary network action
issues.problem: Recommendation is reachable only via a Results tab that disappears after optimization; prerequisites conflict with area selection.
issues.scope: Add an explicit action with inline prerequisites and a dedicated results view independent of Pareto Solutions; allow keeping the drawn area while selecting ≤5 cells.
acceptance_criteria: Action visible in Network mode with prerequisite status
Recommendations reachable after an optimization
Area can be reused without forcing 8-cell selection
Workflow test: optimize → recommend → apply as scenario
non_goals: Changing candidate scoring or adding interference to it

issues.proposed_title: Name report and project downloads meaningfully
issues.problem: Reports download as '<uuid>.md'; project exports are always '<slug>.atom-project.json'.
issues.scope: Use '<project>-<scenario>-v<N>-<yyyymmdd>[-<kind>].<ext>' with safe slugs; keep report_id in metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Report and project filenames include project, scenario/Version (when present) and date
Filenames are filesystem-safe and deterministic for a given artifact
E2E asserts suggestedFilename pattern

issues.proposed_title: Remove duplicate sections and inline SVG bloat from Markdown reports
issues.problem: Markdown reports repeat 'RF Result' as 'RF Propagation Performance', include an empty-ish executive 'RF result' table for single-cell plans, and embed ~600 lines of SVG.
issues.scope: Deduplicate sections; omit irrelevant constraint rows; move the map to a separate attachment/HTML-only view; make the lineage line consistent with the Report source card.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicated tables in single-cell or network reports (snapshot test)
Markdown under a documented size for the sample plan
Lineage line matches stored Report metadata
non_goals: Changing report claims or limitations text

issues.proposed_title: Separate view changes from input changes in stale-result messaging
issues.problem: Switching planning mode marks results 'out of date' with hash-first copy; run history and badges use hashes; Version wording differs between header and Results.
issues.scope: Classify invalidation reasons; use human run labels (type · cells · score · time) with hash in details; one Version-state vocabulary; scenario auto-names follow mode.
acceptance_criteria: Mode switch without input change shows a neutral 'different plan mode' state
Run labels lead with type, cell count and headline metric
Header and Results use identical Version-state wording
Unit tests for reason classification

issues.proposed_title: Make connection, server and validation errors actionable
issues.problem: Backend down shows 'Failed to fetch' and 'Cell No tower'; 500 shows 'internal error'; invalid fields lack inline errors and the prompt points to Inventory.
issues.scope: Map known failure classes to cause + recovery with a Retry action; aria-invalid and inline message on invalid fields; prompts reference the tool owning the field.
acceptance_criteria: Backend-unreachable state names the API origin and offers Retry
Invalid numeric input shows inline message and aria-invalid
Prompt navigates to the owning tool
Interception tests for unreachable/500/429

issues.proposed_title: Resolve map chrome collisions at desktop sizes
issues.problem: Map key swallows area-drawing clicks and clips; '28.0 GHz' overprints 'RF details' at 1280×800; Results tabs overflow at every width; heading focus ring looks like an input.
issues.scope: Collapse the Map key during drawing/placing; legend scrolls without clipping; command-bar truncation rules; tab labels fit; subtler programmatic-focus style.
acceptance_criteria: No overlap at 1440×900, 1280×800, 1024×768 in light and dark (screenshot review)
Area vertices can be placed anywhere on the visible map
Tablist fits without horizontal scroll at ≥1280

issues.proposed_title: Fix project-menu keyboard behavior and control naming
issues.problem: Escape does not close the project menu; trigger label ignores expanded state; 'Save version' has accessible name 'Save current'; two controls named 'Select cells'.
issues.scope: Add Escape handling with focus return; label-in-name alignment; distinct names.
acceptance_criteria: Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
Visible and accessible names match for Save version
Unique accessible names for primary action and map mode
Interaction test

issues.proposed_title: Promote Measurement Validation out of Data → Research
issues.problem: CSV measurement validation with explicit calibration is hidden in a Research disclosure, while a different campaign tool in RF Diagnostics uses similar wording.
issues.scope: Give CSV Measurement Validation a first-class location and name; label the campaign tool as research evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Measurement Validation reachable in ≤2 clicks from the rail
Campaign tool renamed to avoid 'measurement validation' collision
Explicit apply and boundary copy unchanged

issues.proposed_title: Offer the bundled sample project from the first-run state
issues.problem: The first screen does not say what A.T.O.M produces; the sample project needs README knowledge.
issues.scope: Dismissible first-run card with one-sentence purpose, 'Run the pre-selected sector', 'Open sample network project' (bundled example) and glossary link.
acceptance_criteria: Shown only when no saved project exists; dismissal persists
Sample opens as a new project and does not overwrite work
Reaching a network result from first load takes ≤3 actions
Workflow test

issues.proposed_title: Add a trade-off chart to network Pareto solutions
issues.problem: Network optimization lists 25 near-identical cards; Experiments already has a Pareto chart.
issues.scope: Two-objective scatter with recommended/selected markers reusing existing chart helpers; list collapses to top N.
acceptance_criteria: Chart is keyboard/screen-reader described
Selecting a point inspects that solution
No new objectives or scoring
issues.github_cross_check: partially (explanation shipped in PR #96; visualization new)

issues.proposed_title: Use Cell terminology in user-facing selection and error copy
issues.problem: 'towers' appears in selection notices, errors and the Report intro despite the Cell/site/tower glossary.
issues.scope: Replace user-facing 'tower' with 'Cell' where a planning Cell is meant; explain 'nearest 8' selection and list chosen Cells.
acceptance_criteria: No user-facing 'tower' where a Cell is meant (grep test on copy constants)
Area-selection notice states the selection rule
non_goals: Renaming API fields or code identifiers

issues.proposed_title: Add UX regression coverage for the core planning loop
issues.problem: No visual snapshots or automated accessibility checks; no tests for apply-without-Version, backend-unavailable copy or Compare reachability.
issues.scope: Add Playwright light/dark screenshot baselines at 1440/1280/1024 for first run, Results and Solutions; axe smoke on main drawers; no-hidden-request assertions for view-only toggles; persistence round trip for result continuity.
acceptance_criteria: Baselines committed and stable in CI
axe smoke reports no critical violations on covered drawers
Tests fail on F01/F04/F06 regressions
